name: Lisle
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lisle, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lisle, IL: Lights of Lisle and the Santa Parade, Once Upon a Christmas, Peppermint Path, Winter Wonderment and trains nearby.
lede: Lisle kicks off the holidays on the first Saturday in December with Lights of Lisle, a Santa parade and tree lighting at Village Hall, while the historic depot down the street hosts Santa at Once Upon a Christmas.
celebrates: Lisle celebrates with its village, park district and heritage society working side by side. The Village of Lisle holds Lights of Lisle on the first Saturday in December, with a Santa Parade, a tree lighting at Village Hall and thousands of luminaria in downtown. On the same afternoon, the Lisle Heritage Society and the Lisle Park District open the Museums at Lisle Station Park for Once Upon a Christmas, where Santa and Mrs. Claus visit in the old depot and blacksmiths hold a holiday workshop. The park district also lights Peppermint Path in Community Park, throws Winter Wonderment for young children, and its Take Note choir sings a holiday concert.
lastyear: For 2025, the Village of Lisle calendar listed Lights of Lisle for Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 2:30 to 6:30 pm, with the Santa Parade at 4:30 pm and the tree lighting at 5 pm, calling it an evening of free holiday cheer. Patch's preview said it was planned with a St. Joan Choir performance, kids' holiday crafts, ice carving demonstrations, face painting, food trucks and DJ music, and the village pointed families to Once Upon a Christmas at Lisle Station Park.
facts: Lisle was incorporated on June 26, 1956, and in 2026 the village is marking its 70th anniversary. Its Christmas celebration centers on the old railroad. The depot at the Museums at Lisle Station Park, where Santa now greets children, was built in 1874 after Lisle's first depot of 1864 burned. Next door, Beaubien Tavern dates to the 1830s and is one of the oldest timber frame buildings still standing in DuPage County. A local history book calls Lisle the Arboretum Village.
trains: Lisle grew up beside the Aurora to Chicago line of the Chicago, Burlington and Quincy Railroad, today's BNSF, and the downtown Lisle train station sits at 1000 Front Street. The Lisle Park District runs a Santa Express ride from that station in December, a round trip to Aurora with Santa visiting each family, and it fills early. At the Museums at Lisle Station Park, kids can see the 1874 depot and CB&Q waycar 14584, built in 1881. The Morton Arboretum adds Pine Whistle Railroad, a model train exhibit with nearly 1,000 feet of track.

kidfact: Santa visits Lisle kids inside a real train depot built in 1874, back when trains carried goods to and from Lisle on the line between Aurora and Chicago.
faq: The Village of Lisle holds Lights of Lisle on the first Saturday in December each year in downtown Lisle. It usually runs in the afternoon and early evening, with a Santa Parade that ends at Village Hall and a tree lighting led by the mayor. Luminaria line the downtown streets after dark, and the village has described it as free holiday cheer.
Where can kids see Santa in Lisle?

Santa arrives in the Santa Parade at Lights of Lisle, then he and Mrs. Claus visit children inside the historic depot at the Museums at Lisle Station Park during Once Upon a Christmas, a free event. The Lisle Park District also offers a Santa visit and photo at Winter Wonderment and a Santa Express train ride, both with a fee.
What is Once Upon a Christmas in Lisle?

It is a free holiday afternoon presented by the Lisle Heritage Society and the Lisle Park District at the Museums at Lisle Station Park, 921 School Street. Families visit Santa and Mrs. Claus, drink hot chocolate and cider, make crafts and write letters to Santa in the Beaubien Tavern, and watch the blacksmiths in their shop.
Are there free Christmas lights in Lisle?

Yes. The Lisle Park District lights Peppermint Path in Lisle Community Park near Van Kampen Stage, 1800 Short Street, every evening in December, and it is free. Downtown Lisle is lined with luminaria on the night of Lights of Lisle. Illumination at The Morton Arboretum in Lisle is a separate, ticketed light show.
Is there a Christmas train in Lisle?

The Lisle Park District runs Santa Express from the downtown Lisle train station, a round trip to Aurora where Santa travels from family to family, stories are read and carols are sung. Registration closes in mid November and the rides fill up, so sign up early. The Morton Arboretum also has a model train exhibit.
